name: Sha'heel
description: A silent kor sky-climber, twin of Khali, who communicates by hand signals and attacks the Pathrazer with a kitesail.

timeline.summary: Nissa joins Hamadi, Bahkut, Alira and the kor twins Khali and Sha'heel, who rope the party for a climb through gravity fields of floating boulders.
timeline.quote: Once everyone was secured, they moved into the gravity fields.

timeline.summary: From their ropes the party sees a Pathrazer spawn of Ulamog emerge below to attack travelers, and Sha'heel drops toward it.
timeline.quote: Nissa looked over her shoulder to see Sha'heel pull out a knife and cut his anchor lines with one smooth motion.

timeline.summary: Khali and Sha'heel snare the Pathrazer with ropes while Nissa pours all her power into earth elementals that crush it.
timeline.quote: the other two hulks bludgeoned the Pathrazer into a wriggling mass of unrecognizable flesh.

relations.quote: Her twin brother Sha'heel never seemed to speak

pages_say.description: A silent kor sky-climber, twin of Khali, who communicates by hand signals and attacks the Pathrazer with a kitesail.
